change: Reduce seats to active users plus a buffer at the next monthly notice date, by cost centre

description: Cancel unused SaaS seats at each contract's notice date

risks_and_exceptions: Savings start at each contract's notice date; contracts whose deadline has passed are locked until the next term, so only 60 % of the unused value is counted. No energy claimed (no factor for SaaS). Needs human decision: contract owners.
